sections.Profile:
The Disco pinball machine, launched by Stern Electronics in June 1977, captures the vibrant disco era with a music and dancing theme. Designed by Wendell McAdams and featuring artwork by Christian Marche, it is equipped with two flippers, two bumpers, and a spinner.

- Manufacturer: Stern Electronics
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Disco, Singing, Dancing, Stern Electronics, 1970s, Music
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Wendell McAdams
- Art: Christian Marche
